---
title: "Post-eigenMT: interaction model significance"
output: html_document
date: '2025-07-30'
---

Count significant G×T interaction eQTLs after eigenMT + BH correction.
Run after 9b_run_eigenmt_interaction.sh finishes.

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

umi_label <- "medianUMI1"
eigenmt_dir <- paste0("/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/results/treatment/",
                       "matrixeqtl/interaction/", umi_label, "/eigenMT/")
drugs <- c("Ale", "Bri", "Cer", "Cri", "Lor")
```

```{r load}
file_names <- list.files(eigenmt_dir, full.names = FALSE)
treatment_celltypes <- unique(sub("_chr[0-9]+_interact_cis\\.txt$", "", file_names))
cat("Conditions found:", length(treatment_celltypes), "\n")

combine_chrs <- function(tc, dir) {
  bind_rows(lapply(1:22, function(chr) {
    f <- file.path(dir, paste0(tc, "_chr", chr, "_interact_cis.txt"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
    df <- tryCatch(read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df$treatment_celltype <- tc
    df
  }))
}

all_results <- bind_rows(lapply(treatment_celltypes, combine_chrs, dir = eigenmt_dir))
cat("Total gene-best rows loaded:", nrow(all_results), "\n")
```

```{r correct}
# BH within each treatment × cell type; drug is the first token before first underscore
all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(drug = sub("^([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", treatment_celltype)) %>%
  group_by(treatment_celltype) %>%
  mutate(BH = p.adjust(BF, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

sig <- all_results %>% filter(BH < 0.05)
```

```{r summarise}
cat("FDR < 0.05\n")
cat("Significant condition-SNP-gene rows:", nrow(sig), "\n")
cat("Unique SNP-gene pairs (across conditions):", nrow(distinct(sig, snps, gene)), "\n")
cat("Unique eGenes:", n_distinct(sig$gene), "\n")

cat("\nPer drug:\n")
sig %>%
  group_by(drug) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs = n(), n_genes = n_distinct(gene)) %>%
  print()

cat("\nPer condition (treatment × cell type):\n")
sig %>%
  group_by(treatment_celltype) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

```{r save}
out_dir <- file.path(dirname(eigenmt_dir), "eigenMT_summary")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_tsv(all_results, file.path(out_dir, paste0("all_results_posteigenMT_BH_", umi_label, ".tsv")))
write_tsv(sig, file.path(out_dir, paste0("sig_fdr05_interaction_", umi_label, ".tsv")))
cat("Saved to:", out_dir, "\n")
```
